facts.text: Hand Tool Carrier was deployed at Ocean of Storms during Apollo 12 in 1969.
A small carrier holding geological hand tools used during the EVAs — tongs, a scoop, core tubes, and sample bags. Left behind to save weight for the lunar samples being brought home.
Engineered specifically to operate in the harsh vacuum and extreme temperatures of the lunar environment.
Carried the tools that collected 34.4 kilograms of lunar samples from six locations, including material from the rim of a crater that revealed the site's impact history.
Status: Remains preserved in the arid regolith at Ocean of Storms.
Left on the surface to save weight for the lunar samples; the tools it carried are archived at the Lunar Sample Laboratory in Houston.
